title: ICS Announces Comprehensive Cooling Technology Seminar in Thailand
text: Learn everything you need to kn ow about cooling towers and air coolers in one day! Attend expert-led sessions and participate in panel discussions on a wide range of topics designed to help owners optimize for maximum efficiency & high availability operations. Seminar topics will cover advanced level design, operation and technologies of cooling towers and air coolers. Participants include owners/operators and EPC Design firms including ICS, ICST, GE Water, Hudson Products, Brentwood Industries, Fuji Electric, Amarillo Gears. The seminar, hosted by ICS Performance Alliance, will take place at the Kantary Bay Hotel from 8: 30 to 5:30 on March 10th, 2016. Contact: INTERNATIONAL COOLING SOLUTIONS (THAILAND) CO., LTD. 159 Serm-Mit Tower 9th Floor, Sukhumvit 21, Asoke Road North Klongtoey, Wattana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand Tel. +66 (0)2260-6598 Fax. +66 (0)2260-6599
